Microsoft Distributable Code - CodeConvoy Windows releases
========================================================

Scope and ownership
-------------------
Microsoft Corporation owns the Microsoft startup and support code incorporated
in these Windows binaries. CodeConvoy.exe (x64, in both the installer and ZIP)
dynamically uses the VC/UCRT, but still incorporates startup/support objects
selected from msvcrt.lib and Windows SDK libraries. The recorded application
toolset is MSVC 14.51.36231 with Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0. Custom NSIS helpers
are no longer included.

The setup stub, uninstaller and prebuilt NSIS plugins have separately recorded
provenance gaps for any embedded Microsoft code. An absence of CRT DLL imports
does not establish that they contain no Microsoft code. The inventory records
these limits; this notice does not declare every native file's inputs known or
every observed input licensed as Distributable Code.

VCRUNTIME140.dll and the Windows UCRT are supplied separately by the user or
operating system. These packages contain no separate Microsoft runtime DLLs or
redistributable installer. This notice concerns incorporated Microsoft code;
it does not grant rights to redistribute separately obtained runtime files.

CodeConvoy's original code and artwork remain under the MIT license in
LICENSE.txt. That grant does not license Microsoft's code. Other third-party
components retain their own licenses. The Microsoft-specific conditions below
do not relicense CodeConvoy's source or restrict rights granted for independent
MIT or other open-source components.

Redistribution conditions
-------------------------
Redistribution of Microsoft Distributable Code depends on the applicable
development-tool/component agreement and its distributable list. Inclusion in
a linked binary is not itself a redistribution grant. Subject to that grant:

- Distribute authorized, unmodified Microsoft object code with an application
  providing substantial primary functionality. For SDK .lib inputs, distribute
  the linked program, not the libraries. SDK code supplied in a setup program
  must remain within that unmodified setup program.
- Preserve Microsoft's copyright, patent and trademark notices. SDK terms
  also require a valid copyright notice for the distributing application.
- Do not imply Microsoft authorship or endorsement through product naming or
  branding. SDK Distributable Code is restricted to Microsoft's operating
  system platform and must not be used in malicious, deceptive or unlawful
  programs.
- Do not modify or distribute Microsoft source in a way that subjects it to
  a license requiring source disclosure/distribution or granting others the
  right to modify that source (an Excluded License). This does not prohibit
  independently licensed CodeConvoy source from remaining MIT licensed.
- The reviewed VS 2026 terms exclude unreleased components, software developed
  with Insiders Channel Software, and software dependent on unreleased
  components. The VS distributable list also excludes preview components.

Recipients and distributors
--------------------------
Distributors must obtain downstream distributors' and external end users'
agreement to terms providing Microsoft Distributable Code protection no weaker
than the applicable Microsoft agreement. Passing on this notice communicates
conditions; its presence alone does not establish that such agreement occurred
or that a complete protective set of terms has been provided.

The distributing licensee also owes Microsoft the defense and indemnification
undertakings specified by its agreement, including related legal costs. The
reviewed VS 2026 clause excepts claims based solely on Distributable Code; the
reviewed SDK clause does not state that exception. These are the distributor's
contractual responsibilities, not an indemnity imposed on ordinary end users
by this notice. Applicable trade/export laws and controlling component terms
must also be observed.

The preceding summary is not a Microsoft license or a substitute for the
controlling agreements. The operative Microsoft-component terms below state
the distributor's conditions for the Microsoft portions. Their inclusion does
not establish Microsoft's permission conclusively or prove recipient agreement.
For CodeConvoy 1.0.0, the maintainer accepts the remaining grant-interpretation
and agreement-effectiveness uncertainty as a documented licensing risk. No
Microsoft condition or distributor undertaking is waived by that decision.

The reviewed identities, evidence and remaining questions are recorded in
THIRD-PARTY-INVENTORY.json and the CodeConvoy source repository's
docs/license-blocker-evidence.md. These references were reviewed on 2026-10-16.


CodeConvoy Windows - Microsoft component terms
Version 1.0.0, 2026-10-16
==============================================

1. Scope and agreement

These terms are offered by your CodeConvoy distributor for the Microsoft-owned
startup and support portions and Microsoft SDK portions incorporated in
CodeConvoy.exe. They also cover any Microsoft startup/support portions
present in the included NSIS setup, uninstaller or plugins, without asserting
which of those files contains such code. These are the "Microsoft portions".
These terms do not license separately obtained runtime DLLs. Microsoft's
ownership is retained.

Subject to its applicable Microsoft rights, your distributor permits use and
copying of the Microsoft portions, and their redistribution as part of the
supplied CodeConvoy binaries, on these conditions.
By knowingly exercising those permissions after receiving these terms and a
reasonable opportunity to review them, you agree to these terms. If you do not
agree, these terms give you no permission to exercise those rights.

CodeConvoy's independent code and artwork remain MIT licensed. These terms do
not limit those rights or rights under other components' independent licenses.

2. Conditions applying only to the Microsoft portions

Keep them unmodified and within CodeConvoy's linked binaries, which provide
substantial independent functionality; do not extract them for standalone
distribution. Use and distribute them for the Microsoft Windows operating
system platform only. Preserve copyright, patent and trademark notices and
CodeConvoy's copyright notice. Do not imply Microsoft authorship or endorsement,
or include these portions in malicious, deceptive or unlawful programs.

Do not circumvent their technical limitations or reverse engineer, decompile
or disassemble them, except as permitted by applicable law or required by
applicable third-party license rights. Do not subject Microsoft source to
terms requiring its disclosure/distribution or granting modification rights.
Comply with applicable import, export, sanctions, destination, end-user and
end-use restrictions. Nothing here authorizes unreleased, preview or debug
Microsoft components or output prohibited by the applicable Microsoft license.

3. Further distribution

With each copy, preserve these terms and the applicable notices. Give downstream
distributors and external end users a reasonable opportunity to review the
Microsoft-component terms before exercising the permissions, and require their
agreement to these terms or terms providing equivalent or greater protection
for the Microsoft portions, including this downstream obligation. File delivery
alone does not demonstrate agreement. You receive no rights here to distribute
additional Microsoft software or libraries.

4. Microsoft protections

To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Microsoft portions are supplied
without warranties, including implied merchantability, fitness and
non-infringement warranties. Subject to section 5, recovery from Microsoft and
its suppliers is limited to direct damages of no more than USD 5; consequential,
lost-profit, special, indirect and incidental damages are excluded, regardless
of the legal theory or prior knowledge of possible loss. These protections
benefit Microsoft and its suppliers. This text imposes no indemnity on an
ordinary end user; it does not discharge a distributor's separate undertakings
to Microsoft under its applicable agreement.

5. Rights preserved

Nothing here excludes nonwaivable statutory or consumer rights, liability that
applicable law does not permit to be limited, or rights under a warranty given
directly by Microsoft. The restrictions above concern only the Microsoft
portions. They do not restrict independent MIT-licensed CodeConvoy source or
grant permission beyond the distributor's applicable Microsoft rights.
